div.div: أُحَادَ [accus. of أُحَادُ] is imperfectly decl., because of its deviation from its original, (S, K,) both in form and in meaning; (S;) [being changed in form from وَاحِدًا, and in meaning from ٱوَاحِدًا: (see ثُلَاثَ:)] you say, جَاؤُوا أُحَادَ أُحَادَ, [احاد being repeated for the purpose of corroboration,] meaning, They came one [and] one, one [and] one; or one [by] one, one [by] one. (S, K.) The dim. of أُحَادُ is ↓ أُحَيِّدٌ , perfectly decl., like ثُلَيِّثٌ [q. v.] &c. (S, in art. ثلث.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
